description: This PHP source file defines the class FactorAuthFactory, which is responsible for creating and managing instances of different factor authentication classes, handling user-specific authentication methods within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: FactorAuthFactory
classes.description: Factory class for managing factor authentication instances based on user data within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: getFactorAuth
methods.description: Returns an instance of a factor authentication class based on the user's configuration, creating it if necessary, or throws an exception if the user is not properly identified.
